DeterminationBasis: Existing T16 tests bound claims to established evidence and scope, define prerequisites for independent-verification claims, verify claimed-profile matrix completeness, and enforce permitted conformance-status assignment. None directly requires every material claim to identify its claim class or otherwise make the specific claimed property unambiguous. Claim classification or equivalent claimed-property identification therefore remains a distinct generic claim-integrity test obligation.

T16-001 requires a material claim to remain bounded to established evidence and evaluated scope, but evaluated scope is not equivalent to explicit identification of the subject to which the claim applies. T16-006, T16-007 and T16-009 address verifier identity, profile-matrix completeness and requirement-status assignment respectively. No existing T16 test directly establishes generic claim-subject identification. This remains a distinct claim-attribution test obligation.
